questions.stem: A 33-year-old male presents to the gastroenterologist with complaints of bloating after meals for the last 3 years. This is the 5th gastroenterologist that the patient has consulted for the same symptoms. In the past, multiple investigations were done but no cause could be found. The symptoms started after the patient lost his job and have been fluctuating since then. The patient has also done massive research on his symptoms online and is quite distressed because of it. What is the likely diagnosis?
